1: Alif Laam Raa. Aise huroof ke baare mein Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein baat ho chuki hai. Is surah ki aayatein Quran ki un aayaton mein se hain jin ke maani wazeh hain.
2: Aey Arab, maine Quran ko tumhari zubaan mein utara, taake tum us ke maani samajh sako.
3: Aey Rasool ﷺ, yeh Quran utar kar main aap ko behtareen qisse sunata hoon. Sachchai, alfaz ki durustagi aur balaghat — teenon mein yeh behtareen hain. Is ke utarne se pehle aap in qisson se bekhabar thay; aap ko in ka koi ilm na tha.
4: Aey Rasool ﷺ, main aap ko woh waqt sunata hoon jab Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne waalid Yaqub se kaha: “Abbajaan, maine khwab mein gyarah sitare dekhe. Sooraj aur chaand bhi dekhe. Main ne un sab ko apne saamne sajda karte dekha.” Yeh khwab Yusuf ke liye khushkhabri ki pehli nishani thi.
5: Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ne apne bete se kaha: “Beta, apna khwab apne bhaiyon se bayan na karna. Woh is ko samajh lenge aur tujh se hasad karenge. Phir hasad mein tere khilaf saazish karenge. Shaytan insan ka khula dushman hai.”
6: “Aey Yusuf, jis tarah tu ne yeh khwab dekha, isi tarah tera Rubb tujhe chun lega. Woh tujhe khwabon ki tabeer sikhayega. Woh tujh par apni niyamat poori karega — nabuwwat bhi dega aur baadshahi bhi. Tujh se pehle us ne tere do baap-dada, Ibrahim aur Ishaq (alaihimus salaam) par bhi apni niyamat poori ki thi, duniya aur aakhirat ki niyamaton ke saath. Tera Rubb apni makhlooq ko jaanta hai aur apni tadbeer mein hikmat wala hai.”
7: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) aur un ke bhaiyon ke qisse mein sabaq hain. Jo log is waqiye ke baare mein poochte hain, un ke liye is mein nasihat hai.
8: Us waqt bhaiyon ne apas mein kaha: “Yusuf aur us ka haqeeqi bhai abba ko hum se zyada mehboob hain, haalanke hum ek bari jamaat hain. Woh unhein hum par kyun tarjeeh dete hain? Hamara khayal hai ke abba bina kisi zahir wajah ke galti kar rahe hain.”
9: Unhon ne yeh bhi kaha: “Yusuf ko qatl kar do, ya kisi door-daraz sarzameen mein phenk do. Phir abba ki poori tawajjoh tumhari taraf ho jayegi aur woh tum hi se mohabbat karenge. Baad mein jab tum apne gunah se tauba kar lo, to neik ban jaoge.”
10: Un mein se ek bhai ne kaha: “Yusuf ko qatl na karo. Usey kisi kuwein mein daal do. Mumkin hai koi guzarne wala usey paa le aur apne saath le jaye. Agar tum waqai us se chhutkara chahte ho, to yeh kam buri baat hai.”
11: Jab woh un se chhutkara pane par muttafiq ho gaye, to apne waalid Yaqub (alaihis salaam) se kaha: “Abbajaan, aap Yusuf ke baare mein hum par bharosa kyun nahin karte? Hum us par shafqat rakhte hain. Jo cheez usey nuqsan pahunchaye, us se hum us ki hifazat karenge. Hum us ki bhalai chahte hain. Hum us ki dekhbhal karenge, yahan tak ke woh aap ke paas salamat wapas aa jaye. Phir aap usey hamare saath kyun nahin bhejte?”
12: “Kal usey hamare saath bhej dein. Woh khoob dil bahlaye aur hamare saath khele. Jo nuqsan usey pahunch sakta hai, us se hum us ki hifazat karenge.”
13: Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ne apne beton se kaha: “Tumhara usey le jana mujhe gamgeen karta hai. Main us se judai bardasht nahin kar sakta. Mujhe yeh andesha bhi hai ke tum apne khel-kood mein mashgool ho aur bheriya usey kha jaye.”
14: Unhon ne apne waalid se kaha: “Hum itni bari tadaad mein hain. Agar phir bhi Yusuf ko bheriya kha jaye, to hum kisi kaam ke nahin. Aisi soorat mein hum ghaate mein hain, kyunke hum usey bheriye se bacha na sake.”
15: Pas Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ne Yusuf ko un ke bhaiyon ke saath bhej diya. Woh unhein door tak le gaye. Phir unhein kuwein ki tah mein daalne par jam gaye. Usi haal mein maine Yusuf par wahi ki: “Tum unhein un ke is amal ki khabar us waqt doge, jab woh pehchan bhi na sakenge ke yeh tum ho.”
16: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhai raat ke waqt apne waalid ke paas aaye. Woh rote hue banne ki koshish kar rahe thay, taake waalid un ka yaqeen kar lein.
17: Unhon ne kaha: “Abbajaan, hum daud ka muqabla karte aur teer chalate hue nikal gaye. Yusuf ko hum apne kapron aur samaan ke paas chhor aaye thay ke un ki nigrani kare. Phir usey bheriya kha gaya. Hum ne aap ko jo bataya hai, us mein hum bilkul sachche hain — magar aap hamara yaqeen nahin karenge.”
18: Unhon ne apni baat ek chaal se pukhta ki. Woh Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ka kamees le aaye, jis par kisi aur cheez ka khoon laga tha. Yeh zahir karna chahte thay ke bheriye ne use khaya hai. Magar kamees phata hua na tha, is liye Yaqub samajh gaye ke woh jhoot bol rahe hain. Unhon ne kaha: “Maamla waisa nahin jaisa tum keh rahe ho. Tumhare nafs ne ek bura kaam tumhari nigah mein khoobsurat bana diya. Main bagair shikwe ke khoobsurat sabr karoonga. Yusuf ke baare mein jo tum keh rahe ho, us ke muqable mein Allah hi se madad maangi jaati hai.”
19: Ek guzarta hua qafila aaya. Unhon ne apne liye paani bharne wale ko bheja. Us ne apna dol kuwein mein utara, aur Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne rassi pakar li. Dol utarne wale ne unhein dekha to khushi se bola: “Khushkhabri! Yahan ek larka hai!” Us ne aur chand doosron ne unhein baaqi qafile se chhupa liya. Woh unhein aisa maal samajh rahe thay jis se tijarat ho sakti hai. Jab unhon ne Yusuf ko bikne wali cheez samjha, Allah jaanta tha ke woh kya kar rahe thay. Un ka koi amal us se chhupa na tha.
20: Paani bharne wale aur us ke saathiyon ne unhein Misr mein chandi ke chand sikkon par bech diya — itne thore ke ginne mein aa jayein. Unhon ne unhein sasta becha, kyunke jald chhutkara chahte thay. Un ki haalat se unhein andaza ho gaya tha ke yeh ghulam nahin hai, aur unhein us ke ghar walon ka khauf tha. Allah un par meharban tha: us ne unhein zyada arse tak un ke paas na rakha.
21: Misr ke jis shaks ne unhein khareeda, us ne apni biwi se kaha: “Is ke saath achha sulook karo aur is ki achhi dekhbhal karo. Mumkin hai yeh hamare kuch kaam aa jaye, ya hum isey beta bana lein.” Maine Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko qatl se bachaya. Maine unhein kuwein se nikala. Maine Aziz ka dil un ke liye naram kar diya. Isi tarah maine unhein Misr ki sarzameen mein qadam jamane ka mauqa diya, taake unhein khwabon ki tabeer sikhaun. Allah apne kaam ka poora maalik hai, aur us ka faisla zaroor poora hota hai. Koi usey majboor nahin kar sakta — woh is se paak hai. Magar aksar log, jo haqeeqat mein kafir hain, yeh nahin jaante.
22: Jab Yusuf (alaihis salaam) apni jismani aur rohani quwwaton ke urooj par pahunche, to maine unhein samajh aur ilm ata kiya. Jo bhalai karne wale meri pairwi karte hain, unhein bhi main aisa hi badla deta hoon.
23: Aziz ki biwi ne chaal aur fareb se Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko behayayi par aamada karna chaha. Us ne darwaze band kar diye, taake dono akele rahein, aur kaha: “Mere paas aao!” Yusuf ne kaha: “Jis cheez ki taraf tu mujhe bula rahi hai, main us se Allah ki panaah maangta hoon. Mere aaqa ne mujhe apne ghar mein achhi tarah rakha hai. Main un ke saath hargiz khayanat nahin karoonga. Agar main khayanat karoon, to zalim thehrunga; aur zulm karne wale kamiyab nahin hote.”
24: Us ne behayayi ka irada kar liya tha. Agar Yusuf (alaihis salaam) Allah ki nishaniyan na dekh lete, to yahi khayal un ke dil mein bhi aa jata — magar un nishaniyon ne unhein roka aur is se door kar diya. Maine unhein apni daleelein dikhayein, taake unhein buraai se paak rakhun aur haraam shahwat aur khayanat se bachaun. Yusuf mere un bandon mein se thay jinhein maine risalat aur nabuwwat ke liye chuna.
25: Dono darwaze ki taraf daude. Yusuf (alaihis salaam) apne aap ko bachane ke liye, aur woh unhein rokne ke liye. Us ne un ka kamees pakar liya aur peechhe se phaar diya. Darwaze par dono ne us ke shauhar ko khara paya. Aziz ki biwi ne dhoke se kaha: “Aey Aziz, jis shaks ne teri biwi ke saath behayayi ka irada kiya, us ki saza qaid ke siwa kuch nahin — ya usey dard-nak azaab diya jaye.”
26: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: “Usi ne mujhe behayayi par aamada karna chaha. Maine us se aisa koi irada na kiya.” Phir Allah ne us ke khandan ke ek bachche ko gehware mein bulwaya, aur us ne gawahi di: “Agar Yusuf ka kamees saamne se phata hai, to woh sachchi hai — kyunke woh unhein apni taraf aane se rok rahi thi — aur Yusuf jhoot bol rahe hain.”
27: “Aur agar kamees peechhe se phata hai, to Yusuf sachche hain — kyunke woh unhein apni taraf bula rahi thi aur woh bhaag rahe thay — aur woh jhoot bol rahi hai.”
28: Aziz ne dekha ke kamees peechhe se phata hai. Woh samajh gaya ke Yusuf (alaihis salaam) sach keh rahe hain. Us ne kaha: “Aey auraton, yeh ilzaam jo tum ne un par lagaya hai, tumhari hi chaalon mein se hai. Tumhari chaalein bari sakht hain.”
29: Us ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) se kaha: “Aey Yusuf, is baat se darguzar kar aur kisi se zikr na kar.” Aur aurat se kaha: “Tu apne gunah ki magfirat maang. Yusuf ko bahkane ki koshish kar ke tu ne gunah kiya hai.”
30: Shehar mein yeh khabar phail gayi. Auraton ke ek giroh ne naapasandidgi se kaha: “Aziz ki biwi apne ghulam ko apni taraf bula rahi hai. Us ki mohabbat us ke dil mein ghar kar gayi hai. Hamara khayal hai ke woh khuli gumrahi mein hai — usey bahkane ki koshish kar rahi hai, aur ghulam hone ke bawajood us se mohabbat rakhti hai.”
31: Aziz ki biwi ne un ki naapasandidgi aur charcha suni. Us ne unhein Yusuf dekhne ki dawat bhej di, taake woh us ka uzr qabool karein. Us ne un ke liye takiya-daar majlis sajai. Bulai gayi har aurat ko khana kaatne ke liye ek chhuri di. Phir us ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) se kaha: “Un ke saamne nikal aao!” Auraton ne unhein dekha to un ke husn se dang reh gayin. Is par unhon ne wohi chhuriyan apne haathon par chala lin, aur kehne lagin: “Allah har aib se paak hai! Yeh larka insan nahin. Jo husn is mein hai, woh insaano mein nahin hota. Yeh to koi mukarram farishta hi ho sakta hai.”
32: Aziz ki biwi ne un auraton ka haal dekha to kaha: “Yeh wohi ghulam hai jis ki mohabbat par tum mujhe malamat karti thin. Maine us ki khwahish ki aur usey bahkane ki koshish ki, magar woh paak-daman raha aur inkaar kar diya. Agar aage woh mera kaha na mane, to qaid-khane mein daala jayega aur zaleel honay walon mein se ho jayega.”
33: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rubb se dua ki: “Aey mere Rubb, yeh auratein mujhe qaid se darati hain. Jis sharmnak kaam ki taraf woh mujhe bula rahi hain, us se mujhe qaid-khana zyada pasand hai. Agar tu un ki chaal mujh se door na kare, to mumkin hai main un ki taraf maayl ho jaun. Agar main un ka kaha maan loon, to nadanon mein se ho jaunga.”
34: Allah ne un ki dua qabool ki. Us ne Aziz ki biwi aur shehar ki auraton ki chaal unhein door kar di. Us ne — woh paak hai — Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ki dua suni. Jo bhi us se dua kare, woh us ki dua sunta hai. Woh Yusuf ka haal bhi jaanta tha, aur un ke siwa har ek ka haal bhi jaanta hai.
35: Aziz aur us ke logon ne un ki be-gunahi ki daleel dekh li thi. Phir bhi unhon ne yeh raye qayam ki ke unhein ek na-maloom muddat ke liye qaid-khane mein daal diya jaye, taake badnami na phaile.
36: Unhon ne unhein qaid-khane mein daal diya. Un ke saath do qaidi saathi bhi daakhil hue. Un mein se ek ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) se kaha: “Maine khwab mein dekha ke main sharab banane ke liye angoor nichor raha hoon.” Doosre ne kaha: “Maine dekha ke main sar par roti uthaye hue hoon, aur parinde us mein se kha rahe hain. Aey Yusuf, humein in khwabon ki tabeer bataiye. Hum aap ko bhalai karne walon mein se samajhte hain; hamare khwabon ki tabeer bata kar hum par ehsan karein.”
37: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: “Baadshah ya kisi aur ki taraf se jo khana tumhare liye muqarrar hai, woh tum tak pahunchne se pehle hi main tumhein tumhare khwabon ki tabeer bata doonga — un ki asal aur un ki soorat. Jo tabeer main deta hoon, woh mere Rubb ne mujhe sikhai hai. Yeh kahanat ya ilm-e-nujoom nahin. Maine us qaum ka deen chhor diya hai jo Allah par iman nahin rakhti aur aakhirat ka inkaar karti hai — haalanke apne dilon mein usey maanti hai.”
38: “Maine apne baap-dada Ibrahim, Ishaq aur Yaqub (alaihimus salaam) ka raasta ikhtiyar kiya hai — sirf Allah ki ibadat ka raasta. Allah apni wahdaniyat mein yakta hai; hamara yeh kaam nahin ke hum us ke saath kisi ko shareek thehrayein. Sirf Allah ki ibadat aur yeh iman, jo humein aur hamare baap-dada ko mila, yeh hum par Allah ka fazl hai. Yeh tamam logon par bhi us ka fazl hai, kyunke us ne un ki taraf isi paigham ke saath nabi bheje. Magar aksar log Allah ki niyamaton par us ka shukr ada nahin karte, balke na-shukri karte hue us ka inkaar karte hain.”
39: Phir Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne qaid-khane ke un dono saathiyon se poocha: “Kya bahut se maaboodon ki ibadat behtar hai, ya us Allah ki, jo yakta hai, jis ka koi shareek nahin? Woh har cheez par ghalib hai, aur us par koi ghalib nahin ho sakta.”
40: “Tum Allah ke siwa sirf un naamon ki ibadat karte ho jo Allah ne muqarrar nahin kiye. Yeh naam tum ne aur tumhare baap-dada ne rakh liye hain; maaboodiyat mein un ka koi hissa nahin. Allah ne koi daleel nahin utari jis se yeh naam rakhna durust thehre. Tamam makhlooq mein hukm sirf Allah ka hai — un naamon ka nahin jo tum ne aur tumhare baap-dada ne gharh liye. Allah — woh paak hai — ne hukm diya hai ke sirf usi ki ibadat ki jaye, aur mana kiya hai ke us ke saath kisi ko shareek thehraya jaye. Sirf Allah ki ibadat hi seedha raasta hai, jis mein koi kaji nahin. Aksar log yeh nahin jaante, is liye woh Allah ke saath doosron ko shareek karte hain aur us ki paida ki hui cheezon ki ibadat karte hain.”
41: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne dono qaidi saathiyon se kaha: “Tum mein se jis ne dekha ke woh sharab ke liye angoor nichor raha hai, woh qaid-khane se nikal jayega aur apne kaam par laut kar baadshah ki khidmat karega. Aur jis ne dekha ke woh sar par roti uthaye hue hai aur parinde us mein se kha rahe hain, woh qatl kiya jayega aur sooli par charhaya jayega, aur parinde us ke sar mein se khayenge. Jis maamle mein tum ne raye maangi thi, us ka faisla ho chuka hai aur woh zaroor pesh aayega. Yeh aisi haqeeqat hai jo tal nahin sakti.”
42: Un dono mein se jis ke bachne ka Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko yaqeen tha — baadshah ka saqi — us se unhon ne kaha: “Baadshah ke saamne mera qissa aur mera haal bayan karna, taake woh mujhe qaid se riha karwa de.” Magar Shaytan ne us shaks ko yeh zikr bhula diya. Is liye Yusuf us ke baad kai saal qaid-khane mein rahe.
43: Ek din baadshah ne kaha: “Maine khwab mein saat moti gaayein dekhi hain, jinhein saat dubli gaayein kha rahi hain. Anaj ki saat hari baaliyan bhi dekhi hain aur saat sookhi baaliyan. Aey sardaron, agar tum khwabon ki tabeer jaante ho, to mujhe is khwab ki tabeer batao.”
44: Unhon ne kaha: “Yeh pareshan khwabon ka majmua hai, is liye is ki koi tabeer nahin ho sakti. Aise mile-jule khwabon ki tabeer ka hum ilm nahin rakhte.”
45: Qaid kiye gaye un do shakson mein se jo bach gaya tha — baadshah ka saqi — usey ek muddat ke baad Yusuf (alaihis salaam) yaad aaye. Usey yaad aaya ke woh khwabon ki tabeer jaante hain. Us ne kaha: “Main kisi jaanne wale se pooch kar tumhein is khwab ki tabeer bata doonga. Mujhe Yusuf ke paas bhej dein.”
46: Woh bachne wala shaks Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke paas pahuncha aur kaha: “Aey Yusuf, aey sachche, humein us khwab ki tabeer bataiye jis mein kisi ne saat moti gaayein dekhi hon, jinhein saat dubli gaayein kha rahi hain, aur anaj ki saat hari baaliyan aur saat sookhi baaliyan.” Us ka maqsad yeh tha ke woh baadshah aur us ke saathiyon ke paas laut jaye, woh baadshah ke khwab ki tashreeh jaan lein, aur Yusuf ki fazilat aur martaba bhi pehchan lein.
47: Is khwab ki tashreeh karte hue Yusuf ne kaha: “Musalsal saat saal khoob mehnat se kheti karo. In saat saalon mein jo kuch kaato, usey baaliyon mein hi rehne do, taake kharab na ho. Haan, us thori miqdar ko nikal lo jo tumhein khaane ke liye darkaar ho.”
48: “Phir in saat sarsabz saalon ke baad saat qehat ke saal aayenge. Un mein log woh sab kha jayenge jo sarsabz saalon mein kaata tha. Sirf woh thori miqdar bachegi jo tum ne jama ki hogi, aur usi se tum beej bo sakoge.”
49: “Phir in qehat ke saalon ke baad ek aisa saal aayega jis mein baarishein hongi aur kheti ugegi. Log woh cheezein nichorenge jinhein nichorne ki zaroorat hoti hai — angoor, zaitoon aur ganna.”
50: Yusuf ki bayan ki hui tashreeh baadshah tak pahunchi. Us ne apne khadimon se kaha: “Yusuf ko qaid-khane se riha kar ke mere paas le aao.” Baadshah ka qasid Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke paas aaya, to unhon ne kaha: “Apne aaqa, baadshah, ke paas laut ja aur us se un auraton ka qissa pooch jinhon ne apne haath kaat liye thay, taake qaid-khane se nikalne se pehle meri be-gunahi wazeh ho jaye. Mera Rubb khoob jaanta hai ke unhon ne mujhe kis tarah bahkane ki koshish ki thi; us se kuch chhupa hua nahin.”
51: Baadshah ne auraton se poocha: “Jab tum ne chaal se Yusuf ko bulaya tha, us waqt kya hua tha? Kya tum ne un ke saath behayayi ka irada kiya tha?” Aziz ki biwi ne apna kiya hua eteraf karte hue kaha: “Ab haqq wazeh ho gaya hai. Maine unhein bahkane ki koshish ki thi; unhon ne mujhe nahin. Woh is dawe mein sachche thay ke woh is ilzaam se bari hain.”
52: Aziz ki biwi ne kaha: “Yeh eteraf main is liye kar rahi hoon ke Yusuf jaan lein — usi ne unhein bahkane ki koshish ki thi, aur woh sachche thay. Maine un ki ghair-maujoodgi mein un par jhoot nahin bandha. Jo kuch hua, us se mujhe wazeh ho gaya ke Allah jhoot bolne aur chaal chalne walon ko kamiyabi nahin deta.”
53: “Main apne aap ko bari nahin kehti. Maine bura kaam karne ka irada kiya tha, aur main apni safai pesh nahin kar rahi. Insan ka nafs aksar buraai ka hukm deta hai, kyunke woh apni khwahishon ki taraf jhukta hai aur un se rukna mushkil hota hai. Haan, jis par Allah reham farma de, us ka nafs usey buraai ka hukm nahin deta. Beshak Allah apne un bandon ko bakhsh deta hai jo us ki taraf tauba karein, aur un par meharban hai.”
54: Yusuf ki be-gunahi aur un ka ilm zahir ho gaya. Baadshah ne apne khadimon se kaha: “Yusuf ko mere paas le aao, taake woh meri khidmat karein.” Woh unhein le aaye. Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne baadshah se baat ki, to un ka ilm aur un ki buland zehanat zahir ho gayi. Baadshah ne kaha: “Aaj ke din se aap sahib-e-martaba, sahib-e-maqam aur amanat-dar hain.”
55: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne baadshah se kaha: “Mujhe Misr ki sarzameen ke maal aur galle ke khazanon ka nigehban muqarrar kar dein. Main amanat-dar nigehban hoon, aur jis cheez ki nigrani karoonga us ka ilm aur basirat rakhta hoon.”
56: Allah ne Yusuf ki be-gunahi sabit ki aur unhein qaid se riha karwaya. Isi tarah us ne unhein Misr ki sarzameen mein qadam jama diye, ke jahan chahein ja kar reh sakein. Allah is duniya mein apni rehmat apne bandon mein se jisey chahta hai deta hai. Woh bhalai karne walon ka ajr zaaya nahin karta, balke poora poora deta hai.
57: Jo log Allah par iman rakhte hain aur us se darte rahe — us ke hukmon ki pairwi karte hue aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hue — un ke liye aakhirat ka ajr duniya ke ajr se behtar hai.
58: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhai apna saudagari ka maal le kar Misr aaye aur un ke saamne hazir hue. Unhon ne pehchan liya ke yeh un ke bhai hain. Magar bhai unhein na pehchan sake, kyunke bahut arsa guzar chuka tha aur woh bahut badal gaye thay. Jab bhaiyon ne unhein kuwein mein daala tha, us waqt woh mehez ek larka thay.
59: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne unhein woh galla aur saamaan de diya jis ke liye woh aaye thay. Unhon ne bata diya ke un ka ek sauteila bhai hai, jisey woh apne waalid ke paas chhor aaye hain. Yusuf ne kaha: “Apne us bhai ko bhi le aao, to main tumhein zyada galla doonga. Kya tum nahin dekhte ke main poora naap deta hoon aur us mein se kuch kam nahin karta? Main behtareen mezban hoon.”
60: “Aur agar tum usey na laaye, to wazeh ho jayega ke tum is dawe mein sachche nahin thay ke tumhara ek sauteila bhai hai. Us soorat mein main tumhein galle ka koi naap nahin doonga, aur tum mere mulk ke qareeb bhi na aana.”
61: Un ke bhaiyon ne jawab diya: “Hum apne waalid se us ke liye darkhwast karenge aur usey lane ki poori koshish karenge. Aap ne jo kaha hai, woh hum bagair kotahi poora karenge.”
62: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne khadimon se kaha: “In logon ka saudagari ka maal unhein wapas laut do.” Un ka maqsad yeh tha ke wapas jaate hue woh samajh jayein ke un ki tijarat nahin hui. Yeh unhein majboor karega ke apne bhai ke saath dobara aayein, apni sachchai sabit karein, aur Yusuf un se un ka maal qabool karein.
63: Woh apne waalid ke paas laut aaye aur unhein Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ki sakhawat ke baare mein bataya. Phir kaha: “Agar hum apne bhai ko saath na le gaye, to humein aage galla nahin diya jayega. Usey hamare saath bhej dein, to humein galla mil jayega. Hum us ki achhi dekhbhal karenge aur usey salamat wapas le aayenge.”
64: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Kya main us ke baare mein tum par waisa hi bharosa karoon jaisa maine us ke haqeeqi bhai Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke baare mein kiya tha?” Unhon ne Yusuf ke baare mein un par bharosa kiya tha aur un se dekhbhal ka wada liya tha, magar unhon ne apna wada poora na kiya tha. Is liye unhon ne un ke is naye wade par bharosa na kiya. Unhon ne Allah par bharosa kiya: wohi behtareen nigehban hai jis ka chahe, aur sab reham karne walon se zyada meharban hai jis par chahe.
65: Unhon ne woh thaile khole jin mein galla tha. Unhein mila ke jo maal unhon ne us ke badle diya tha, woh wapas kar diya gaya hai. Unhon ne apne waalid se kaha: “Is baadshah se itni sakhawat ke baad hum aur kya chahein? Hamara maal us ne apni meharbani se humein laut diya hai. Hum apne ghar walon ke liye galla le aayenge. Apne bhai ki us cheez se hifazat karenge jis ka aap ko andesha hai. Us ke saath jane par ek oont ka bojh zyada bhi milega — aur baadshah ke liye ek oont ka bojh koi bari baat nahin.”
66: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Main tumhare bhai ko tumhare saath hargiz nahin bhejunga, jab tak tum Allah ki qasam na kha lo ke usey wapas le aaoge. Haan, agar tum sab par halakat chha jaye aur tum mein se koi baaqi na rahe, aur tum na kuch kar sako aur na laut sako, to aur baat hai.” Unhon ne apne waalid ko Allah ke naam par pukhta wada diya. Tab unhon ne kaha: “Jo kuch tum keh rahe ho, us par Allah gawah hai, aur us ki gawahi hamare liye kaafi hai.”
67: Unhon ne yeh nasihat bhi ki: “Misr mein sab ek hi darwaze se daakhil na hona, balke alag alag darwazon se daakhil hona. Agar koi tum sab ko nuqsan pahunchana chahe, to yeh is lihaz se zyada mehfooz hai.” Unhon ne yeh is liye nahin kaha ke woh koi nuqsan rok sakte ho jo Allah ne muqarrar kiya ho, ya koi faida la sakte ho jo Allah ne na chaha ho. Faisla sirf Allah ka hai aur hukm sirf us ka. Unhon ne kaha: “Main apni zindagi ke har maamle mein usi par bharosa karta hoon. Bharosa karne walon ko usi par bharosa karna chahiye.”
68: Pas woh Yusuf ke haqeeqi bhai ke saath safar par nikle. Woh alag alag darwazon se daakhil hue, jaisa un ke waalid ne kaha tha. Magar is se woh kuch na ruk saka jo Allah ne un ke liye muqarrar kiya tha. Yeh to mehez Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ki apne beton ke liye fikr thi, jo unhon ne nasihat ki soorat mein zahir ki. Woh jaante thay ke faisla sirf Allah ka hai. Allah ne unhein taqdeer par iman aur ehtiyat ikhtiyar karna sikhaya tha, magar aksar log yeh nahin jaante.
69: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhai un ke saamne aaye, un ke haqeeqi bhai ke saath. Unhon ne apne haqeeqi bhai ko qareeb kiya aur chupke se kaha: “Main tera bhai Yusuf hoon. Apne doosre bhaiyon ki be-ehtiyati par gam na kar.” Un bhaiyon ne dono ko takleef aur ranj pahunchaya tha, aur Yusuf ko kuwein mein daala tha.
70: Phir Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne khadimon se kaha ke bhaiyon ke oonton par galla laad dein. Baadshah ka paimana, jis se galla naapa jata tha, unhon ne chupke se apne haqeeqi bhai ke thaile mein rakh diya, taake woh un ke paas reh jaye. Bhai safar par nikal kar apne ghar walon ki taraf laut rahe thay ke ek pukarne wale ne un ke peechhe awaz di: “Tum, apne oonton par galla laade hue, chor ho!”
71: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhai us pukarne wale aur us ke saathiyon ki taraf mure aur bole: “Tumhari kaun si cheez gum hui hai, jis par tum humein chori ka ilzaam de rahe ho?”
72: Pukarne wale aur us ke saathiyon ne kaha: “Baadshah ka woh paimana gum hua hai jis se hum naapte thay. Jo talashi se pehle usey pesh kar de, usey ek oont ka bojh inaam milega; main is ki zamanat deta hoon.”
73: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhaiyon ne Allah ki qasam kha kar kaha: “Tum khud jaante ho ke hum is se bari aur be-gunah hain — hamari haalat se tumhein maloom hai. Hum Misr ki sarzameen mein fasaad phailane nahin aaye, aur hum kabhi chor nahin rahe.”
74: Pukarne wale aur us ke saathiyon ne poocha: “Agar tum apne is dawe mein jhoothe nikle, to tumhare han chori ki saza kya hai?”
75: Yusuf ke bhaiyon ne kaha: “Hamare han kisi chor ki saza yeh hai ke jis ke thaile se chori ka maal mile, woh usi ka ghulam ban jaye jis ka us ne chori ki.” Un ke han choron ko isi tarah saza di jaati thi.
76: Pas woh unhein Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke paas laut laaye, ke un ke thaile dekhe jayein. Unhon ne apne sauteile bhaiyon ke thaile pehle dekhe, aur apne haqeeqi bhai ka thaila baad mein — taake un ka asal irada chhupa rahe. Phir unhon ne us ka thaila dekha aur us mein se baadshah ka paimana nikal liya. Allah ne Yusuf ke liye yeh tadbeer ki thi ke paimana un ke bhai ke thaile mein rakha jaye. Usi ne — Yusuf ke faide ke liye — yeh bhi tadbeer ki ke un ke bhaiyon par un hi ke mulk ki saza aa jaye, yani chor ko ghulam bana lena. Agar baadshah ki saza par amal hota, jo maar aur jurmana thi, to yeh na hota. Allah maamlaat ko jis tarah chahe tartib dene par qadir hai. Woh apne bandon mein se jisey chahe us ka darja buland karta hai, jaisa us ne Yusuf ka darja buland kiya. Har ilm wale ke oopar koi us se zyada ilm wala hai, aur sab ke ilm ke oopar Allah ka ilm hai, jo har cheez ko jaanta hai.
77: Yusuf ke bhaiyon ne kaha: “Agar us ne chori ki hai to taajjub nahin; is ka haqeeqi bhai bhi is se pehle chori kar chuka hai.” Un ki murad Yusuf (alaihis salaam) thay. Yusuf ne un ki is baat ka ranj dil mein chhupa liya aur ji mein socha: “Is maamle mein asal buraai tumhara hasad aur tumhare kiye hue bure kaam hain.” Jo jhoot woh bol rahe thay, Allah usey khoob jaanta tha.
78: Unhon ne kaha: “Aey Aziz, hamare waalid buzurg aur umr-rasida hain, aur is bhai se bahut mohabbat karte hain. Is ki jagah hum mein se kisi ek ko rakh lein. Hum dekhte hain ke aap hamare aur doosron ke saath bhalai karne wale hain; yeh kar ke hum par ehsan karein.”
79: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: “Main Allah ki panaah maangta hoon ke kisi be-gunah ko kisi zalim ke gunah mein pakrein. Agar hum us ke siwa kisi doosre ko rakh lein jis ke thaile se paimana mila hai, to hum zalim thehrenge — kyunke hum be-gunah ko saza denge aur mujrim ko chhor denge.”
80: Woh Yusuf (alaihis salaam) se apni darkhwast qabool hone se mayoos ho gaye. Phir logon se alag ho kar apas mein mashwara karne lage. Un ke bare bhai ne kaha: “Kya tumhein yaad nahin ke abba ne tum se Allah ke naam par pukhta wada liya tha ke tum un ka beta laut ao ge? Siwaye is ke ke tum us cheez se ghere jao jisey tum rok na sako. Aur is se pehle tum Yusuf ke maamle mein kotahi kar chuke ho; abba se kiya hua wada poora nahin kiya. Main Misr ki sarzameen nahin chhorunga, jab tak abba mujhe laut aane ki ijazat na dein, ya Allah yeh faisla na kar de ke main apne bhai ko le ja sakoon. Allah behtareen faisla karne wala hai; woh haqq aur insaaf ke saath faisla karta hai.”
81: Bare bhai ne kaha: “Abba ke paas laut jao aur unhein batao: aap ke bete ne chori ki hai, aur Misr ke Aziz ne usey us ki chori ki saza ke taur par ghulam bana liya hai. Hum aap ko wohi bata rahe hain jo hum ne apni aankhon se dekha — paimana us ke thaile se nikalte dekha. Hum nahin jaante thay ke woh chori karta hai; agar jaante hote to aap se usey laut lane ka wada na karte.”
82: Apni sachchai sabit karne ke liye unhon ne kaha: “Us shehar walon se pooch lein jahan hum thay, aur us qafile walon se bhi jis ke saath hum aaye hain. Woh bhi aap ko wohi batayenge. Apne bete ki chori ke baare mein jo hum ne bataya hai, us mein hum sachche hain.”
83: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Maamla waisa nahin jaisa tum keh rahe ho. Tumhare nafs ne is maamle ke dhoke ko tumhari nigah mein khoobsurat bana diya, jaisa tum pehle apne bhai Yusuf ke baare mein kar chuke ho. Mera sabr khoobsurat sabr hai; woh shikwa sirf Allah ke saamne rakhta hai. Mumkin hai Allah Yusuf, us ke haqeeqi bhai aur tumhare bare bhai — sab ko laut de.” Woh — paak hai — Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ka haal jaanta tha, aur un ke liye har cheez ki tartib mein hikmat wala tha.
84: Unhon ne un se munh pher liya aur kaha: “Haye Yusuf ka gam!” Gam ki shiddat se un ki aankhon ki siyahi safed ho gayi. Woh gam aur ranj se bhare hue thay, magar apna gam logon se chhupaye hue thay.
85: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ke bhaiyon ne waalid se Allah ki qasam kha kar kaha: “Aap Yusuf ko yaad karna aur un par gam karna nahin chhorenge, yahan tak ke aap sakht beemar ho jayein ya mar jayein.”
86: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Main apna gam aur ranj sirf Allah ke saamne rakhta hoon. Main Allah ki meharbani aur sakhawat ko, zaroortmandon ki pukar par us ke jawab ko, aur museebat uthane walon ke liye us ke ajr ko jaanta hoon — jo tum nahin jaante.”
87: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Jao, aur Yusuf aur us ke bhai ki khabar laao. Allah ki rehmat se, aur us ke apne bandon ko nijaat dene se, mayoos na hona.” Allah ki rehmat se sirf kafir log mayoos hote hain, kyunke woh Allah ki qudrat ki azmat aur apne bandon par us ke poshida fazl ko nahin jaante.
88: Unhon ne waisa hi kiya jaisa waalid ne kaha tha, aur Yusuf (alaihis salaam) aur us ke bhai ki talash mein nikle. Yusuf ke saamne aa kar bole: “Hum sakht tangi aur muflisi mein hain, aur ghatiya, sasta maal laaye hain. Humein poora naap de dein, jaisa pehle diya tha. Is se zyada de kar hum par sadqa karein, ya hamare ghatiya maal se darguzar karein. Allah sadqa karne walon ko behtareen ajr deta hai.”
89: Yusuf ne un ki baat suni to unhein un par taras aaya. Unhon ne bata diya ke woh kaun hain, aur poocha: “Kya tum jaante ho ke tum ne Yusuf aur us ke haqeeqi bhai ke saath kya kiya tha, jab tum is ke anjaam se nadan thay?”
90: Woh hairan hue aur poocha: “Kya tum waqai Yusuf ho?” Unhon ne kaha: “Haan, main Yusuf hoon, aur yeh mera haqeeqi bhai hai. Allah ne hum par ehsan kiya — humein pehli haalat se bachaya aur hamare darje buland kiye.” Jo bhi taqwa ikhtiyar kare aur mushkil par sabr kare, us ke aamaal achhe hain. Allah bhalai karne walon ka ajr zaaya nahin karta, balke usey un ke liye mehfooz rakhta hai.
91: Bhaiyon ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) se maafi maangi aur kaha: “Allah ne kamaal ki sifaat de kar aap ko hum par tarjeeh di hai. Jo hum ne aap ke saath kiya, us mein hum ne buraai aur nafarmani ki.”
92: Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne un ka uzr qabool kiya aur kaha: “Aaj ke din se tum par na koi ilzaam hai jis par saza bane, aur na koi malamat. Allah tumhein maaf farma de.” Woh — paak hai — sab reham karne walon se zyada meharban hai.
93: Unhon ne Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ko apne waalid ki aankhon ka haal bataya. Yusuf ne apna kamees un ke hawale karte hue kaha: “Yeh kamees le jao aur apne waalid ke chehre par daal do; is se un ki nigah laut aayegi. Aur apne tamam ghar walon ko mere paas le aao.”
94: Qafila Misr se nikal kar abadi se door hua. Tab Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ne apne paas walon se kaha: “Mujhe Yusuf ki khushboo aa rahi hai — agarche tum kahoge ke main nadan hoon aur aisa buzurg hoon jo apni baat ka hosh nahin rakhta.”
95: Un ke paas walon ne Allah ki qasam kha kar kaha: “Aap abhi tak apne usi purane khayal mein kho hue hain — Yusuf ki ahmiyat aur unhein dobara dekh pane ke imkan ke baare mein.”
96: Phir khushkhabri lane wala woh cheez le kar aaya jis se Yaqub (alaihis salaam) khush hote. Unhon ne Yusuf ka kamees apne chehre par daala, aur un ki nigah laut aayi. Phir unhon ne apne beton se kaha: “Kya maine tum se nahin kaha tha ke main Allah ki meharbani aur us ke fazl ko us tarah jaanta hoon jaise tum nahin jaante?”
97: Beton ne apne waalid Yaqub (alaihis salaam) se maafi maangi aur kaha: “Abba, Allah se hamare pichhle gunahon ki magfirat ki dua karein. Jo hum ne Yusuf aur us ke haqeeqi bhai ke saath kiya, us mein hum gunahgar aur zalim thay.”
98: Un ke waalid ne kaha: “Main tumhare liye apne Rubb se magfirat ki dua karoonga.” Beshak woh apne un bandon ke gunah bakshne wala hai jo us ki taraf tauba karte hain, aur un par meharban hai.
99: Yaqub (alaihis salaam) aur un ke ghar wale apni sarzameen chhor kar Misr mein Yusuf ke paas pahunche. Woh un ke saamne aaye, to Yusuf ne apne waalid aur waalida ko gale lagaya, aur apne bhaiyon aur un ke ghar walon se kaha: “Allah ne chaha to salamati ke saath Misr mein daakhil ho jao; yahan tumhein koi takleef na pahunchegi.”
100: Unhon ne apne waalidain ko usi takht par bithaya jahan woh khud baithte thay. Un ke waalidain aur gyarah bhaiyon ne sajda kar ke un ka ikraam kiya — jo un ki shariyat mein jaiz tha. Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne waalid se kaha: “Abba, sajde ke zariye yeh ikraam usi khwab ki tabeer hai jo maine pehle dekha tha aur aap ko sunaya tha. Mere Rubb ne is waqiye ke zariye usey haqeeqat bana diya. Us ne mujh par meharbani ki: mujhe qaid-khane se nikala, aur in sab ko sehra se mere paas le aaya, jab ke Shaytan ne mere aur mere bhaiyon ke darmiyan bigar daal diya tha.” Un ka Rubb jo chahta hai, us ki tadbeer mein nihayat bareek-been hai. Woh apne bandon ke haalat ko jaanta hai aur apni tadbeer mein hikmat wala hai.
101: Phir Yusuf (alaihis salaam) ne apne Rubb ko pukara: “Aey mere Rubb, tu ne mujhe Misr mein iqtidar diya aur mujhe khwabon ki tabeer sikhai. Tu aasmanon aur zameen ka paida karne wala hai; tu ne unhein us waqt wujood mein laya jab un jaisa kuch na tha. Duniya ki zindagi mein mere tamam maamlaat ka kaarsaz tu hai, aur aakhirat mein bhi tu hi hai. Meri umr ke anjaam par meri rooh us haal mein qabz kar ke main tera farmanbardar hoon, aur mujhe apne baap-dada aur doosre neik nabiyon ke saath jannat ke buland tareen darje mein mila de.”
102: Aey Rasool ﷺ, Yusuf (alaihis salaam) aur un ke bhaiyon ke qisse se jo kuch bayan hua, Allah ne woh sab aap par wahi kiya. Is se pehle aap ko is ka koi ilm na tha. Aap us waqt un ke saath maujood na thay, jab woh Yusuf ko kuwein ki tah mein daalne par muttafiq hue aur apni chaal ki tadbeer ki. Yeh sab Allah ne aap par wahi kar diya.
103: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aksar log iman nahin layenge, chahe aap un ke iman lane ke liye poori koshish kar lein. Is liye aap un ke gam mein apni jaan na ghulayein.
104: Agar woh apni aql istemal karte, to aap ﷺ par iman le aate. Aap ne Quran par koi ajr nahin maanga, aur na us cheez par jis ki taraf aap unhein bulate hain. Quran to tamam logon ke liye ek nasihat hai.
105: Aasmanon aur zameen mein Allah ke yakta hone ki be-shumaar nishaniyan phaili hui hain. Kafir un ke paas se guzarte hain, magar un par sochte nahin aur gaur nahin karte. Woh un se munh phere hue hain.
106: Aksar log Allah ko paida karne wala, rizq dene wala, zinda karne wala aur maut dene wala maante hain. Magar saath hi woh tasweeron aur buton ki ibadat bhi karte hain, ya yeh dawa karte hain ke us ki aulad hai — woh is se paak hai!
107: Kya mushrikeen is baat se be-khauf hain ke duniya mein koi azaab unhein ghere aur dabo de, aur woh usey rok na sakein? Ya is se ke qayamat un par achanak aa jaye, jab woh gaafil hon aur us ki tayyari na kar sakein? Kya isi wajah se woh iman nahin laate?
108: Allah apne Rasool ﷺ se kehta hai ke jin logon ko aap haqq ki taraf bulate hain, un se keh dijiye: “Yeh mera raasta hai. Main poori basirat ke saath Allah ki taraf bulata hoon, aur mere saathi bhi, jo meri hidayat se hidayat pate aur sunnat par chalte hain. Main un mein se nahin jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek thehrate hain; main sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karta hoon — woh paak hai!”
109: Allah ne Rasool ﷺ se pehle sirf mardon ko bheja, farishton ko nahin. Unhein us ne wahi di, jaisa woh Rasool ko deta hai. Woh shehron ke rehne wale thay, sehra ke nahin. Un ki qaumon ne unhein jhutlaya, aur Allah ne unhein halak kar diya. Jo log Rasool ko jhutlate hain, kya woh zameen mein chal-phir kar nahin sochte ke un se pehle jhutlane walon ka anjaam kya hua? Aakhirat ke ghar ki niyamat un ke liye behtar hai jo duniya mein taqwa ikhtiyar karte hain. Kya woh yeh nahin samajhte? Phir unhein Allah ke hukmon ki pairwi karni chahiye — sab se bara hukm iman hai — aur us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachna chahiye, aur sab se bari mana ki hui cheez shirk hai.
110: Allah ne un rasoolon ke dushmanon ko mohlat di; saza mein jaldi na ki, balke unhein dheere dheere dheel di. Phir jab un ki halakat ka waqt aa gaya, rasool apni qaum se mayoos ho gaye. Kafiron ne gumaan kiya ke rasoolon ne unhein jhoote wade diye thay — jhutlane walon ke azaab aur iman walon ki rihai ke wade. Tab Allah ki madad us ke rasoolon ke paas aa gayi. Us ne rasoolon aur iman walon ko us halakat se bacha liya jo kafiron par aayi. Aur Allah ka azaab, jab woh usey utarta hai, gunahgaron se taala nahin ja sakta.
111: Rasoolon aur un ki qaumon ke qisson mein aql walon ke liye sabaq hain — jaisa Yusuf (alaihis salaam) aur un ke bhaiyon ke qisse mein hai. Quran, jis mein yeh waqiyat hain, woh baatein nahin jo Allah ke baare mein gharh li gayi hon. Woh Allah ki utari hui aasmani kitabon ki tasdeeq hai. Woh har us cheez ki tafseel hai jis ki tashreeh shariyat ke zariye darkaar hai. Woh har bhalai ki taraf hidayat hai, aur un logon ke liye rehmat hai jo us par iman rakhte hain — kyunke wohi log us se faida uthate hain.
